provenance.consistency: Each file copied only when inode, size, mtime and ctime stayed unchanged through the copy. Cross-file clocks are not synchronized.
provenance.scope: All regular files present in tutorials/**/samples/** at capture inventory; no decimation or exclusions; source files left unchanged.
provenance.working_tree: Includes uncommitted updates being published alongside this snapshot.

scientific_status: Lossless per-file stable snapshot of every existing tutorial samples directory, including study samples and superseded branches. Captured while simulations may be running; clocks vary by file and case. These are observational samples, not a coordinated numerical restart checkpoint or a claim of completed or scientifically qualified runs.
